title: SynoPkgOpenList 4.2.7-0013
body:
<!-- synopkgland:release:synopackageland%2FSynoPkgOpenList:4.2.7-0013 -->

SynoPkgOpenList **4.2.7-0013**

4.2.7-0013
- Native OIDC single sign-on from the DSM main menu; DSM administrators only. One designated administrator owns the OpenList admin account; other administrators receive ordinary OpenList accounts.
- Adds 49 bounded ctl commands; business commands verify the designated owner and writes require confirmation.
- Rebuilt with released CLI/templates/SDK/App 0.19.0, executor/v0.19.0 and UI 0.12.5. CLI check/build/inspect pass with findings=[].
- Upgrade from 0012 preserves existing data and settings; OIDC, non-administrator denial and three read-only ctl commands were checked. Manual shared-folder permissions and Local storage setup remain required. External WebDAV is not enabled.

Package: `synopackageland/SynoPkgOpenList`

[Browse packages](https://synopkgland.com/apps/)
